findings.title: Named-function scope was inaccurate
findings.evidence: Required dynamic-array/generation functions were missing while conditional aggregates were presented as within scope.
findings.recommendation: Teach all named functions and clearly mark supplementary work.
findings.resolution: Teach all named functions and clearly mark supplementary work.

findings.title: Spill placement needs explicit handling
findings.evidence: Spilled formulas belong outside tables and need clear output space.
findings.recommendation: Add blocked-output diagnosis and deterministic sequence example.
findings.resolution: Add blocked-output diagnosis and deterministic sequence example.

findings.title: Empty-text formulas overlap cell counts
findings.evidence: COUNTA and COUNTBLANK can both include a formula returning empty text.
findings.recommendation: Add a six-cell example with exact expected counts.
findings.resolution: Add a six-cell example with exact expected counts.

findings.title: Formatting does not restore lost data
findings.evidence: Numeric conversion can lose leading zeros or long-identifier precision.
findings.recommendation: Require typed import and comparison with original data.
findings.resolution: Require typed import and comparison with original data.

findings.title: Visible and full totals differ
findings.evidence: Standard Total Row aggregates use SUBTOTAL.
findings.recommendation: Teach filtered population reconciliation against an ordinary SUM.
findings.resolution: Teach filtered population reconciliation against an ordinary SUM.
